The aim of this work is to study the terahertz and microwave rotational spectra of methylamine experimentally and theoretically in order to provide a reliable basis for the detection of its rotational transitions in the first torsionally excited state
This paper makes use of the following ALMA data: ADS/JAO.ALMA#2016.1.00074.S.
